 "command": "cat > programs/task-959059f6.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    # The most common color in the canvas (excluding nothing) is the panel background.
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != background]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != background]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    panels = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            panels.append((r0, r1, c0, c1))
    # Copy the most populated panel's non-background pattern into every panel.
    src = max(panels, key=lambda p: sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(p[0],p[1]) for c in range(p[2],p[3])))
    sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1 = src
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1, c0, c1 in panels:
        for r in range(r0, r1):
            for c in range(c0, c1):
                out[r][c] = grid[sr0 + (r-r0)][sc0 + (c-c0)]
    return out
